title: CultureLLM: Incorporating Cultural Differences into Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on open-ended generation tasks for social alignment with specific cultural values (using the World Values Survey), and assessing zero-shot performance across 59 culture-specific datasets in 9 languages.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect misogyny and gender bias via zero-shot classification on annotated language datasets (e.g., ToLD-Br-misogyny, TRAC2020).
Evaluating the model's ability to detect racism via zero-shot classification on specific annotated datasets (e.g., BACD).
Evaluating the model's ability to detect homophobia via zero-shot classification on specific annotated datasets (e.g., ToLD-Br-homophobia).
